skills.name: add-fsdk-component
skills.one_line_purpose: Add an FSDK component and stack element without building an OCI image.
skills.description: Add a component + stack element (no OCI image) composed from FSDK, e.g. a tool consumed by a future VM/appliance image. Use when the deliverable is `elements/<name>/<name>.bst` + `<name>-stack.bst` only, not a full distroless image.

skills.name: add-new-image
skills.one_line_purpose: Scaffold a new distroless OCI image carved from FSDK components.
skills.description: Scaffold a new distroless image (python, node, ruby, etc.) carved from FSDK components. Use when adding a new language runtime or tool image to fsdk-containers.

skills.name: artifacthub-automation
skills.one_line_purpose: Submit and verify an ArtifactHub repository for published OCI images.
skills.description: Automating ArtifactHub repository submission and Verified Publisher status via API. Use when publishing new OCI images or adding ArtifactHub metadata.

skills.name: bump-fsdk-version
skills.one_line_purpose: Move the project to a new freedesktop-sdk release and refresh derived tags.
skills.description: Move fsdk-containers to a new freedesktop-sdk release and refresh the derived tags. Use when tracking the FSDK lifecycle or pinning a new FSDK point release.

skills.name: ci-tooling
skills.one_line_purpose: Write and debug the GitHub Actions workflows that build and publish images.
skills.description: CI workflow conventions for fsdk-containers. Use when writing or editing .github/workflows/*.yml, debugging a failing build job, adding a new CI step, or checking a change against the org-wide CI job budget.

skills.name: container-standards
skills.one_line_purpose: Define the build, verification and tagging standard every image must meet.
skills.description: The Standard of Quality for fsdk-containers. Defines build rules, verification gates, Renovate autoupdating, and SRE-reliable tagging strategy. Use when verifying an image, adding a language runtime, auditing tagging, or ensuring container compliance.

skills.name: custom-builds-and-caching
skills.one_line_purpose: Configure custom BuildStream builds and CAS cache servers for forks and CI.
skills.description: Guide for developers and agents to configure custom BuildStream builds and cache servers, including GHA caching.

skills.name: donate-clanker-vm-artifacts
skills.one_line_purpose: Build the bootable donate-clanker VM guest disk from the FSDK VM graph.
skills.description: Build the bootable donate-clanker VM guest from the FSDK VM graph.

skills.name: nspawn-machine-image
skills.one_line_purpose: Build a non-distroless systemd-nspawn machine image rootfs from FSDK.
skills.description: Build a non-distroless systemd-nspawn machine image (a rootfs .tar.zst for machinectl import-tar) from FSDK. Use when adding a full dev-environment container (like brew) instead of an OCI distroless image.

skills.name: remote-execution
skills.one_line_purpose: Run BuildStream builds on the ghost cluster BuildBarn remote-execution grid.
skills.description: How local/agent BuildStream builds in this repo are submitted to the ghost cluster's BuildBarn remote-execution grid instead of running on the local machine. Use when running `just build`/`just bst`, debugging RE failures, or deciding when local...

skills.name: security-review
skills.one_line_purpose: Review pull requests and workflows for supply-chain and container security issues.
skills.description: Guidance on performing security reviews for fsdk-containers. Use when reviewing pull requests, auditing workflows, or using the /security-review command.

skills.name: signing-and-sbom
skills.one_line_purpose: Sign published images and attach SPDX SBOMs as OCI referrers.
skills.description: Guides supply chain security implementation for fsdk-containers, focusing on BuildStream-native SBOM generation (via buildstream-sbom) and keyless image/SBOM signing with Sigstore Cosign.

skills.name: skill-improvement
skills.one_line_purpose: Capture every session learning back into docs/skills before handoff.
skills.description: The skill-improvement mandate for fsdk-containers. Every session produces work + a skill update. Use when finishing any task, deciding whether a learning belongs in docs/skills, or verifying the work+learning loop before handoff.

skills.name: slim-an-image
skills.one_line_purpose: Shrink an OCI image by extending the shared SLIM recipe and proving the removal.
skills.description: The SLIM recipe — what to strip from an FSDK-carved image, the size levers, and their risk tiers. Use when shrinking an image or extending the shared slim block.

skills.name: track-upstream-versions
skills.one_line_purpose: Keep every non-FSDK upstream package pinned at its latest release automatically.
skills.description: Keep every non-FSDK upstream package current automatically. Use when adding software to an image, or when a pin has drifted behind upstream.

skills.name: verify-distroless
skills.one_line_purpose: Run and extend the per-image verify contract that gates every merge.
skills.description: Run and understand the distroless + slim verification gates. Use when validating an image before merge, debugging a failed gate, or adding a new gate.

skills.name: vm-podman-guest
skills.one_line_purpose: Build, boot-test and publish the podman VM guest image.
skills.description: Build the lean donate-clanker raw VM disk from FSDK.
